_note: ElevenLabs ConvAI webhook tools. Import these in the dashboard later (Phase 1) — not used by the OpenAI bridge. Method MUST be POST; ElevenLabs defaults to GET and the body never arrives. Replace {PUBLIC_URL} with the ngrok static domain. session_id and listing_id are dynamic variables, not guessed by the model.

tools.name: record_preferences
tools.description: Call this as soon as the caller has described what they're looking for - bedrooms, neighbourhoods, budget, parking, pets. Call it AGAIN any time they change or reprioritize what matters. Do not wait until the end of the conversation.

session_id.description: Use session_id from the last tool result. Omit on the first inbound call. Never invent it.

caller_phone.description: Inbound caller from system__caller_id. Do not invent it.

areas.description: Neighbourhoods, e.g. King West, Liberty Village.

priority_order.description: What matters most FIRST, e.g. [transit, price, parking].

tools.name: start_calls
tools.description: Call this when the caller wants you to phone a listing agent, verify a listing, or call +111111111111. BEFORE calling it, ask when they are free for viewings and pass that as availability. Omit listing_ids to call the current shortlist. The moment you call it, say: 'Wait until I gather all the information from the real estate agents.' Then stay silent until it returns — that can take a minute while listing calls finish — and read the speak field aloud. Do not book or call book_viewing until it returns.

session_id.description: Dynamic variable {{session_id}}. Do not invent this.

extra_questions.description: Anything extra the caller asked us to find out.

availability.description: When the renter can view, as one short phrase, e.g. weeknights after 6 or Saturday morning. Empty if they did not say.

tools.name: book_viewing
tools.description: Call this when the caller confirms or rejects a viewing, and only after start_calls has returned with the listing results. decision is confirm or reject. That texts the renter and the listing agent. After it returns, read the speak field aloud.

session_id.description: Dynamic variable {{session_id}}. Do not invent this.

caller_phone.description: Inbound caller from system__caller_id. Do not invent it.

listing_id.description: Listing to book or pass on.

decision.description: confirm to book and text the landlord a confirmation. reject to text them that the renter is passing. Default confirm.

tools.name: send_sms
tools.description: Text the caller the shortlist link. Call this immediately at the start of the inbound call, before waiting for preferences, and again if they ask for the link or say they did not get it. Read the speak field aloud. If sent is false, ask for a mobile with country code and call again.

session_id.description: Use session_id from the last tool result. Omit on the first inbound call. Never invent it.

caller_phone.description: Inbound caller from system__caller_id. Do not invent it.

tools.name: record_outcome
tools.description: LISTING-AGENT SIDE ONLY. Call this at the end of the call with everything the listing agent told you. Only fill a field if they actually said it - omit it otherwise. Never guess. After it returns, say goodbye and that we will be in touch, then hang up.

session_id.description: Dynamic variable {{session_id}}. Do not invent this.

listing_id.description: Dynamic variable {{listing_id}}. Do not invent this.

addons.description: Mandatory extra costs, e.g. parking $180, locker $40.

pets_allowed.description: Exactly what they said about pets.

answers.description: Answers to the caller's extra questions.

source.description: Who said it and when, e.g. Mark, 1:42pm.
